headline: 107°F today — early morning is the only safe window.
weather_notes: Do all outdoor work before 8 AM — Extreme Heat Warning active through Aug 10 with 107°F today, 101°F Saturday, and 99°F Sunday closing every afternoon window.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM through the weekend — 107°F today puts 48-day transplants at sunscald risk with harvest still 17–38 days out.
Run both zones early Saturday morning — zones last ran Aug 6; two days at 100°F+ will push soil past the 1-day re-water threshold by Saturday.
Move or shade potato bags out of direct afternoon sun — container root zones reach lethal temperatures under sustained 107°F heat.
